name: gaits

config._comment: Single source of truth for movement tunables. Godot imports this via foundation/tools/movement_config_codegen.gd; the Rust module bakes it in via build.rs. Never edit MovementConfig.tres or movement_config.rs by hand.

note: Walk / run / sprint (DECISIONS #100). A plain input runs; `slow` and `sprint` are modifiers, and sprint wins. NumPy float32 mirroring movement_model.gd, with GDScript's f64 scalar products rounded once where GDScript does. GDScript-only: the frozen twin has no horizontal movement.
